justification: I didn't want to make moves, moves are admitting the universe got to you, but then I look at my own lineup and THREE guys are sitting there on a bye like it was scheduled just to humiliate me personally - Kyren Williams, Drake London, gone, very convenient timing. London I can fix, DJ Moore's healthy, he slides into WR2. Kyren's getting replaced by Emmett Johnson - yeah, I paid fourteen bucks for a rookie because he dropped thirty-two on Kansas City and I refuse to be the only owner in this league who didn't see that coming, laugh all you want. Jordan Mason finally plays too - I paid thirty-one dollars for that man once already and sitting him again is just paying for the privilege of being an idiot twice. Tucker Kraft stays at tight end because I own exactly zero other tight ends, so I am legally required to start a man who isn't even suiting up, and if that's not proof the whole system's rigged against me specifically, I don't know what is. Tennessee's still serving its two-week bad-luck suspension after the negative-one debacle - I called it, I paid my two dollars for Chicago, done, not relitigating it. And Geno - questionable, again, OF COURSE - sits for Herbert, who's somehow playing in that exact same game, because for once in my life I'm taking the healthy guy over the hope. Leon Black's sitting at eight and two acting like the season's over. We'll see about that Sunday.
